replication.target_description: Source-defined focal replication claim: effect of VIX (lnvix) on quoted spread for NASDAQ stocks, 2010–2019 annual-screening data; mean of estimated focal coefficients from separate entity regressions tested against zero (P17, P25–27, P61, P64, P77–82). No row-order or numeric matching used.

es.quote: In the original paper the estimated coefficient is positive (0.4644) and significant. In the replication, the estimated coefficient is negative (-0.02) and significant (p=0.025).

notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a paragraph-numbered DOCX extraction with Source: https://osf.io/download/xg6q5/, matching the assigned replication file URL. P3–5/P13–17 identify a replication of Chung & Chuwonganant (2014), Journal of Financial Economics, and name the replication team (Bob Reed, Diem Vo, Jianhua Duan, Sanghyun Hong, Tom Coupe). P84 identifies the original title Uncertainty, market structure, and liquidity, volume 113 issue 3, pages 476–499. The document is a primary replication report, with Replication Results, deviations and reproducibility-file descriptions, rather than an abstract or preregistration. Its internal date is November 17, 2020 (P8), differing from the supplied reference date November 18, 2025; no DOI is printed for the replication. Only the assigned replication effect-size field is extracted. P30 explicitly prints the focal coefficient -0.02; retain this coefficient in its printed metric although requested metric is d. No standardisation or conversion to d is justified by the supplied source. P37/P40 separately report mean/median t-statistic summaries (-0.068/-0.079); these are not attached as the test statistic for the P30 coefficient. No PDF was supplied; embedded results images are absent from this DOCX text, and the separately referenced Chung_Results file is outside the supplied material. Unassigned n, p, original and reported_success fields are placeholders, not negative findings.
